Bug_Title: The non-serializable super class of a "Serializable" class should have a no-argument constructor
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the non-serializable super class of a 'Serializable' class should have a no-argument constructor bug. The SerializableClass extends NonSerializableClass which does not have a no-argument constructor. This will cause a runtime error when deserializing an instance of SerializableClass.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case attempts to serialize and deserialize an instance of the SerializableClass. The deserialization process fails because the super class NonSerializableClass does not have a no-argument constructor.
